checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Product matches matte black bottle, silhouette and lid
must.why: Bottle and lid look faithful across frames; slight proportion change as camera approaches.

must.item: Multiple moving views/close-ups in clean studio setting
must.why: One continuous push-in on a kitchen table, not a studio; no distinct multiple views.

must.item: Opening 'Your everyday bottle' and ending 'Shop now'
must.why: No text visible in any frame.

must.item: Mellow music audible, no spoken voice
must.why: Audio exists (peak -6.6 dB) but its content can't be judged.

faults.what: Only 5 s long instead of about 15 s.
No opening or closing text or call to action.
Kitchen table background, not a clean studio; only one push-in move.
Slightly soft, low-res frames; bottle base looks slightly warped in the first frame.

summary: A faithful-looking 5 s square push-in on the bottle in its original kitchen, but it lacks the 15 s 9:16 length, studio setting, multiple views and the required text.
